owner_rules: Done means ALL evidence: implemented as specified (task id), a test that FAILED before and passes now, suites green, measured number vs target, docs regenerated, committed AND pushed to the contract's branch.
Never defer: no "later", "follow-up", "out of scope". If blocked: what blocks, what you tried, what you need; then continue with the next task.
Root cause, then fix: file:line + mechanism. No weakening tests, raising timeouts, skips, relaxed assertions.
No silent scope cuts: never lower targets, caps or test sizes without owner approval.
Never bypass guards: no --no-verify, no bypass env vars, no skip flags.
Deliver continuously: one task per commit, pushed to the contract's branch as it goes green.
Honest reporting: TASK-ID | status | commit | tests | measured vs target | missing.

tasks.description: State may cross a boundary only as a contribution the receiving node can verify and judge. This contract defines the signature and admission block of the operation envelope of PG-04.1 and the node's own admission: verify the signature (the role key of MEM-145 through the same ssh-keygen path, offline), check authority and policy for the scope and classification, then append; a failed step records a rejected event in the vault's operation log through the OpLog API and appends nothing of the payload. Replay is refused through a per-sender sequence whose high-water mark is persisted through the operation log, so it survives a restart (the restart rule of SR-1.03). A signature proves a key signed; authority is a separate check. The external admission service of SO-F-08 runs before this step when configured. The classification field's values are constrained later by the classification schema of SO-F-05.

criteria.statement: a contribution is an operation envelope (PG-04.1) that carries subject, scope, a classification string whose values the classification schema of SO-F-05 constrains later, schema version, causal context, provenance, payload hash, a per-sender sequence and a signature made with the role key of MEM-145 through the same ssh-keygen path, in a namespace distinct from the role-binding namespace, and verified offline; the schema docs/schemas/contribution-v1.json defines only the signature and admission block, not a second envelope; the validator accepts the fixtures and refuses a missing field

title: SO-F-03 Contribution signature and two-step admission: a signed, scoped, classified contribution built on the operation envelope, admission into the node's own operation log, replay refused across restarts, and authority checked apart from the signature
request: Build layer of the Scope One programme, adapted from the unsigned fold of 30 Oct 2026 (fold id SO-F-03) and validated against memev main at d1c65ef. Contracts marked with a dagger are signed in the owner's vault and are not visible in this repository; they are cited by id only. Implements the design records SO-2.02 (Permission-aware knowledge access: retrieval governed by identity, project membership, classification, policy and jurisdiction); SO-2.03 (Provenance, retention and invalidation of organisational knowledge) (contracts/scope-one/specs). The decision record cites this contract by id and keeps only the gaps this one does not cover. Builds on signed vault contracts: MEM-145†. Memev contracts that land first: SO-F-01, SO-F-02. Page: docs/FEDERATION.md comes from the federation architecture documentation (PR #223, branch docs/federation-architecture, not on main); until that merges, the first contract to need a page creates it with its Status section, labelled planned or architectural target, and the later ones extend it. Source in the fold: #222 section 13.7 (signed structured contributions; accountable admission) and #223 FEDERATION.md (state exchange with versioned contracts, provenance and defined reconciliation). Settled decisions this contract follows (owner decision 31 Oct 2026, docs/scope-one/DECISIONS.md): topology is local-first and the cloud is only a relay and a backup; every supported provider stands on equal footing and no work or tier depends on one; crdt-merge is reached only through the provider boundary of src/engine/merge.mjs (docs/EXTENSION-POINTS.md) and this contract adds no merge engine to the core; tiers follow docs/PRICING.md (Free core, Personal for up to 3 computers with no per-computer add-on, higher tiers by contacting us) with no Personal trial; the git backup keeps running every few minutes (sync.interval_min). Memory authority: ADR 7 (memory and project-state authority) is proposed in PR #325 and is not decided here; this contract cites it and the local-first decision, and keeps one store under the vault with no second database. Provenance: adapted from the unsigned fold of 30 Oct 2026. Changes: (1) converted from the vault task format to the memev spec format (named tests run as red-green checks on the own test file of the contract; inline regular expression flags became the flags key; hygiene and decision verifiers became commands or doc checks). (2) removed fold-only fields and the owner-decision marker field, reworded the stop rule that named a patent, and made the text pass the leak scan. (3) Duplicate removed: the operation envelope of PG-04.1 (docs/OPERATION-ENVELOPE.md, src/engine/envelope.mjs, test/envelope.test.mjs) is the one envelope. The fold defined a second envelope and the same test name; this contract now adds only the signature and admission block (docs/schemas/contribution-v1.json), the per-sender sequence and the rejected event, and builds on PG-04.1. (4) src/engine/agentid-bind.mjs added to scope: its signMessage is private and it verifies only role bindings, so federation code had no generic verify through the same ssh-keygen path. A namespaced verify is exported there, so src/engine/federation imports no child_process. The signature uses a namespace distinct from the binding namespace, so a role-binding signature cannot be replayed as a contribution signature. (5) Replay refusal must survive a restart: devices.mjs NonceCache is a 10-minute in-memory cache, so the per-sender sequence high-water mark is persisted through the operation log and rebuilt on open (the restart-proof replay rule of SR-1.03 is the pattern; it is cited, not copied). (6) Absorbed from the dropped SO-F-11: a guard that src/engine/federation imports no child_process, net, http, https or dgram module. (7) The fold docs heading ## Contribution envelope becomes ## Contribution and admission, so it does not suggest a second envelope.
